## Formula checklist

Mark items that do not apply as N/A (e.g. `- [x] N/A: ...`) for non-formula PRs.

- [ ] I verified each new or modified formula against the cited source.
- [ ] Each formula has at least one authoritative reference (see the source priority in CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I opened and checked the cited source directly, not only a search snippet or summary.
- [ ] I did not invent bibliographic metadata or locators; unverified fields are left empty.
- [ ] I verified any notation differences between the code and the cited source.
- [ ] I stated assumptions and applicability in original wording.
- [ ] I did not copy copyrighted explanatory prose, figures, tables, or examples.
- [ ] I checked the evaluator against at least one known numerical case.
- [ ] The formula is registered in the correct domain `FORMULAS` tuple.
- [ ] I did not bypass `ReferenceSpec` / `FormulaSpec` validation.

## General checklist

- [ ] The `validate-catalog` check passes.
- [ ] Docs (README / CONTRIBUTING) are updated if behavior or conventions changed.
